text:
Maria (ml-eng): Quick bakeoff TL;DR: ran GPTQ vs AWQ vs INT8 vs FP8 on Llama-2-13B, Mistral-8x, Qwen-14B across convQA, GSM8K, and long-form summarization. Seeing non-linear accuracy deltas by family, and a KV-cache degradation on Qwen with some GPTQ variants. Dashboard: https://redwood-inference.internal/bakeoffs/2365432100

Jason (research): Nice, can you paste the top-level numbers? even rough deltas are fine.

Maria (ml-eng): Sure — top-level (avg over evals):
- Llama-2-13B: GPTQ -0.8% acc, AWQ -0.4%, INT8 -1.9%, FP8 ~0.0%
- Mistral-8x: GPTQ -1.3%, AWQ -0.2%, INT8 -2.4%, FP8 +0.1%
- Qwen-14B: GPTQ -3.1% (but skewed on long context convQA), AWQ -0.7%, INT8 -3.6%, FP8 -0.2%
Numbers are mean absolute performance change vs float32 baseline.

Sara (infra): When you say KV-cache degradation on Qwen, what's the symptom? increased latency? wrong tokens?

Maria (ml-eng): It's correctness drift on long prefix reuse: after ~8k tokens of cached KV reuse, GPTQ variants occasionally return stale or repeating snippets on convQA chains, ~0.5% of prompts fail smoke checks. Latency fine, it's a generation quality issue.

Kevin (sre): Are these GPTQ builds using per-channel group sizes we normally ship? or default 128 grouping? if it's small groups that might explain instability.

Jason (research): We used the default GPTQ-8 config from the repo except one sweep with group=64. The group=64 runs reduced the Qwen regression to ~2.0% but increased quant noise on Mistral. So there's a tradeoff.

Maria (ml-eng): Actionable recs we've drafted:
1) Dedicated deployments: prefer AWQ for Qwen long-context workloads; GPTQ only if group>=64 + flat KV caching enabled.
2) Hosted (fastest path): use FP8 for latency-sensitive read-heavy workloads where accuracy delta is negligible.
3) Private/on-prem: expose quant profile toggle (gptq_group) and a canary route.

Jason (research): Quick note on numeric stability: some GPTQ kernels we used didn't include the new kv-normalization fix. Once we patched that in local runs the Qwen drift dropped another ~0.6%.

Sara (infra): Can you share the patch snippet? will add to build matrix.

Jason (research): 
```
# small patch to normalize kv before pack in the GPTQ path
kv = kv / (kv.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
pack_kv(kv, group_size=group)
```

Maria (ml-eng): Also spotted workload-specific failure modes: math tasks (GSM8K) are more sensitive to INT8 rounding; Mistral shows tokenization edge-cases with AWQ if we don't preserve EOS logits in the tail.

Kevin (sre): From infra side, performance profiles:
- GPTQ (group=128) on Dedicated A100: p50 45ms/token, p95 120ms/token (13B)
- AWQ on same infra: p50 38ms, p95 95ms
- FP8: p50 30ms, p95 70ms
So FP8 is compelling if accuracy holds.

QA-Bot: Automated regression checks: 12/240 prompt sets flagged on Qwen-GPTQ baseline. Details at https://redwood-inference.internal/qa/2365432100

Maria (ml-eng): Proposal: ship AWQ as default for Mistral & Qwen in hosted, keep FP8 opt-in, block GPTQ for Qwen in hosted until kv-normalization + group>=64 are in mainline. Can we get SRE + infra buy-in?

Kevin (sre): +1 from SRE — we don't want to risk user-facing hallucination regressions. Need a canary and automated eval gate.

Sara (infra): I'll add the patch to the CI matrix and enable canaries on the dedicated pool. ETA tomorrow morning for the CI job.

Jason (research): I'll prepare a short note for model-onboarding docs with the recommended quant flags and the KV caveat.

Maria (ml-eng): Thanks team — I'll open the rollout PR and link the bakeoff artifacts. If anyone wants to add microbenchmarks or extra prompt sets, drop them in the thread. :rocket:
